To determine the cost of filling the swimming pool, we need to calculate the volume of the pool in gallons.

### Step 1: Calculate the volume of the pool in gallons
The pool is 14 feet wide, 25 feet long, and 4 feet deep.
The volume of the pool in gallons is:
\[
\text{Volume} = \frac{\text{Area} \times \text{Depth}}{\text{Gallon}}
\]
The area of the pool is:
\[
\text{Area} = \text{Width} \times \text{Length} = 14 \times 25 = 350 \text{ square feet}
\]
The depth is 4 feet, so the volume in gallons is:
\[
\text{Volume} = \frac{350 \times 4}{5.9} = \frac{1400}{5.9} \approx 237.11 \text{ gallons}
\]

### Step 2: Calculate the total cost
The cost for the pool company to come and fill the pool is $0.10 per gallon.
The total cost is:
\[
\text{Total Cost} = \text{Volume} \times \text{Cost per gallon} = 237.11 \times 0.10 = \$23.71
\]

### Final Answer
The total cost to fill the pool is \boxed{\$23.71}.
